📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough The metadata cache gains a configurable `pinnedChildFn` predicate and a rebuild-safe deletion helper. Two `doEnsureVisited` call sites replace plain `DeleteFolderChildren` with `deleteFolderChildrenForRebuild`, which snapshots and reinserts pinned children instead of discarding them. The WFS mount wires `isLocalOnlyEntry`—checking dirty handles and pending async flushes—as that predicate at construction time. ## Changes **Pinned-child rebuild coherence** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **MetaCache struct, pinned predicate, and rebuild-safe deletion helper**
`weed/mount/meta_cache/meta_cache.go` | Adds `pinnedChildFn` field to `MetaCache`, exports `SetPinnedChildFn`, and introduces `deleteFolderChildrenForRebuild` which snapshots pinned children before wiping a directory and reinserts them afterward. | | **Rebuild call-site swap and WFS `isLocalOnlyEntry` wiring**
`weed/mount/meta_cache/meta_cache_init.go`, `weed/mount/weedfs.go` | Replaces both `DeleteFolderChildren` calls in `doEnsureVisited` with `deleteFolderChildrenForRebuild`. Adds `isLocalOnlyEntry` to `WFS` (checks dirty handles and `pendingAsyncFlush`) and registers it as the pinned-child callback in `NewSeaweedFileSystem`. | | **EnsureVisited pinned and unpinned behavior tests**
`weed/mount/meta_cache/meta_cache_build_test.go` | `TestEnsureVisitedPreservesLocalOnlyEntry` verifies a pinned local-only child survives a filer-listing rebuild. `TestEnsureVisitedDropsUnpinnedStaleEntry` verifies a stale unpinned child is evicted when no predicate is set. | ## Sequence Diagrams ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant mount as Mount/EnsureVisited participant rebuild as deleteFolderChildrenForRebuild participant predicate as isLocalOnlyEntry participant storage as MetaCache Storage mount->>rebuild: rebuild directory path rebuild->>storage: snapshot all children storage-->>rebuild: child list loop for each child rebuild->>predicate: check if local-only predicate-->>rebuild: boolean result end rebuild->>storage: delete all children rebuild->>storage: reinsert pinned children only storage-->>mount: rebuild complete ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes ## Poem > 🐇 Hop hop, my files won't disappear, > Even when the cache rebuild draws near! > The pinned ones stay, the stale ones go, > A predicate guards each pending row. > No local create shall vanish in fright— > The singleflight bunny keeps order just right! 🌟

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
